rules.statement: In probate proceedings, the propounder must affirmatively establish that the testator was of sound mind and competent to make a will if the question of sanity or majority is impeached.
rules.supporting_quote: "So in view of what I have said, if it is necessary to decide this matter, I should be strongly inclined to hold that once the defence of minority is set up, it is for the party propounding the will to prove that the alleged testator was a man of full age."
